description: This file contains code related to exporting models to ONNX format in PyTorch, including status tracking, report formatting, and file generation functions.

classes.name: ExportStatus
classes.description: Data class tracking various steps and success statuses of the ONNX export process.

methods.name: str _status_emoji(status: bool | None)
methods.description: Returns an emoji representing the success, failure, or indeterminate status of a process.

methods.name: str _format_export_status(status: ExportStatus)
methods.description: Formats the export status into a markdown code block with emojis.

methods.name: str _strip_color_from_string(text: str)
methods.description: Removes ANSI color codes from a string.

methods.name: str _format_exported_program(exported_program: torch.export.ExportedProgram)
methods.description: Converts an exported program to a readable markdown string, removing color codes.

methods.name: str construct_report_file_name(timestamp: str, status: ExportStatus)
methods.description: Generates a filename for the report based on export statuses and timestamp.

methods.name: str format_decomp_comparison( pre_decomp_unique_ops: set[str], post_decomp_unique_ops: set[str], )
methods.description: Formats a comparison of operations before and after decomposition.

methods.name: str format_verification_infos( verification_infos: list[_verification.VerificationInfo], )
methods.description: Formats verification information into a readable string.

methods.name: None create_torch_export_error_report( filename: str | os.PathLike, formatted_traceback: str, *, export_status: ExportStatus, profile_result: str | None, )
methods.description: Creates a markdown error report file for failed PyTorch ONNX export attempts.

methods.name: None create_onnx_export_report( filename: str | os.PathLike, formatted_traceback: str, program: torch.export.ExportedProgram, *, decomp_comparison: str | None = None, export_status: ExportStatus, profile_result: str | None, model: ir.Model | None = None, registry: _registration.ONNXRegistry | None = None, verification_result: str | None = None, )
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive markdown report file for successful or failed ONNX export attempts.

ctags.name: create_onnx_export_report
ctags.signature: ( filename: str | os.PathLike, formatted_traceback: str, program: torch.export.ExportedProgram, *, decomp_comparison: str | None = None, export_status: ExportStatus, profile_result: str | None, model: ir.Model | None = None, registry: _registration.ONNXRegistry | None = None, verification_result: str | None = None, )

ctags.name: create_torch_export_error_report
ctags.signature: ( filename: str | os.PathLike, formatted_traceback: str, *, export_status: ExportStatus, profile_result: str | None, )
